name: deploy
description: Ship a build to an environment
usageNote: A target is a named environment from deploy.toml; files default to everything the build produced.

commands.name: rollback [release]
commands.description: Return to a previous release, the last one by default

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show what is live in each environment

options.name: -p, --port <number>
options.description: Port the health check listens on

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the plan without applying it

options.name: --region <name>
options.description: Cloud region for the deploy, which also decides where logs and artefacts are kept

options.name: --max-parallel-uploads <n>
options.description: Upload at most this many files at once

examples.comment: Deploy the current build to staging
See what would change in production

environment.name: NO_COLOR
environment.description: Turn colour off; bold is kept
